name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)

ministry.name: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

overview: A credit-linked subsidy scheme for generating self-employment opportunities by helping set up new micro-enterprises in the non-farm sector through bank-financed projects with government subsidy.
objectives: Generate employment opportunities through micro-enterprise creation
Provide financial support for setting up new self-employment ventures
Bring together traditional artisans and unemployed youth into self-employment

benefits.title: Margin Money Subsidy
benefits.description: Government subsidy of 15-35% of project cost depending on category and area, with the balance as bank loan

education: Minimum Class VIII pass for projects above a specified cost
otherCriteria: New units only; existing units already availing government subsidy not eligible

Does your proposed project involve capital expenditure?
Is another member of your family (self, spouse or unmarried children) already receiving PMEGP financial assistance for setting up a new enterprise?

applicationProcess.description: Apply online through the PMEGP e-portal
Application scrutinised by District/State Task Force
Approved applicants undergo mandatory EDP training
Bank sanctions loan and subsidy is credited upon disbursement

faqs.question: What is the maximum project cost covered?
faqs.answer: Up to Rs. 50 lakh for manufacturing and Rs. 20 lakh for service sector units.

faqs.question: Is training mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, Entrepreneurship Development Programme training is mandatory before final disbursement.

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)

ministry.name: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
ministry.department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises / SIDBI

overview: A scheme providing collateral-free credit guarantee cover to loans extended by eligible lending institutions to micro and small enterprises, easing access to formal credit.
objectives: Facilitate collateral-free credit to micro and small enterprises
Encourage banks and financial institutions to lend to MSEs
Strengthen the credit delivery system for the MSE sector

benefits.title: Guarantee Cover
benefits.description: Guarantee cover of up to 85% of the loan amount depending on category and loan size, without collateral or third-party guarantee

otherCriteria: New and existing micro and small enterprises seeking collateral-free credit from eligible lending institutions

customQuestions.question: Is your business classified as a Micro or Small Enterprise (MSE) under the applicable MSME definition?
Is your enterprise engaged in an eligible manufacturing or service activity?
Is your enterprise new or existing?  New / Existing  Both eligible  4  Is the proposed credit facility a term loan and/or working capital facility from an eligible lending institution?
Are you applying through a CGTMSE Member Lending Institution (MLI) such as an eligible bank/financial institution?
Is your enterprise not an SHG or JLG?
Is your enterprise engaged in agriculture as its primary activity?
Do you have the required PAN/IT-PAN before availing the credit facility?

applicationProcess.description: Apply for a loan with an eligible bank/NBFC/lending institution
Lending institution assesses proposal and avails CGTMSE cover
Loan disbursed to the MSE without collateral requirement

faqs.question: What is the maximum guarantee cover?
faqs.answer: Up to 85% of the credit facility depending on the category of borrower and loan amount.

faqs.question: Who administers CGTMSE?
faqs.answer: A trust set up by the Ministry of MSME and SIDBI.

name: Udyam Registration

ministry.name: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
ministry.department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

overview: A simplified, free online self-declaration based registration process for micro, small and medium enterprises, enabling them to be officially classified as MSMEs and access related benefits.
objectives: Provide a simple, paperless registration process for MSMEs
Enable MSMEs to access government schemes and benefits
Create a national database of registered MSMEs

benefits.title: Official MSME Recognition
benefits.description: Udyam Registration Certificate enabling access to priority sector lending, subsidies and government tenders

benefits.title: Ease of Access to Schemes
benefits.description: Simplified access to CGTMSE, PMEGP and other MSME-linked benefits

otherCriteria: Any micro, small or medium enterprise engaged in manufacturing or service activities

Are you willing to provide the required information through self-declaration?

applicationProcess.description: Enter Aadhaar and PAN details for self-declaration
Provide business investment and turnover details

faqs.question: Is there a registration fee?
faqs.answer: No, Udyam Registration is completely free.

faqs.question: Is Udyam Registration mandatory?
faqs.answer: It is required to avail most MSME-related government scheme benefits.

name: Credit Linked Capital Subsidy for Technology Upgradation (CLCS-TUS) under MSME Champions

ministry.name: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
ministry.department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

overview: A scheme providing capital subsidy to micro and small enterprises for upgrading their plant and machinery with state-of-the-art technology, improving quality and competitiveness.
objectives: Facilitate technology upgradation in micro and small enterprises
Enhance competitiveness of the MSE sector

benefits.title: Capital Subsidy
benefits.description: Upfront capital subsidy on institutional finance availed for approved technology upgradation

otherCriteria: Existing micro and small enterprises upgrading with approved technology/machinery under specified sub-sectors

customQuestions.question: Is your enterprise a Micro or Small Enterprise (MSE)?
Does your enterprise have a valid Udyam Registration?
Is your enterprise engaged in an eligible manufacturing activity/sub-sector covered under the scheme?
Are you obtaining institutional credit/term loan from an eligible lending institution for technology upgradation?
Are you purchasing new approved plant and machinery/equipment or approved technology?
Is the investment in eligible plant and machinery/technology within Γé╣1 crore for calculation of subsidy?
Is the machinery/equipment new rather than second-hand or fabricated?
Is the proposed technology/plant and machinery intended for technology upgradation/improvement of productivity, quality or related performance?

applicationProcess.description: Apply through the eligible primary lending institution
Lending institution appraises and sanctions term loan for technology upgradation
Subsidy claim processed through the nodal agency
Subsidy credited to the enterprise's loan account

faqs.question: What does the subsidy cover?
faqs.answer: Capital subsidy on institutional finance used for approved plant and machinery upgradation.

faqs.question: Which enterprises are eligible?
faqs.answer: Existing micro and small enterprises in specified sub-sectors adopting approved technology.

name: Zero Defect Zero Effect (ZED) Certification Scheme

ministry.name: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

overview: A scheme encouraging MSMEs to adopt Zero Defect Zero Effect manufacturing practices, promoting quality products with minimal environmental impact, along with subsidised certification costs.
objectives: Promote quality manufacturing with zero defects among MSMEs
Encourage environmentally sustainable ('zero effect') production practices
Improve MSME competitiveness in domestic and export markets

benefits.title: Subsidised Certification
benefits.description: Significant subsidy on ZED certification costs for MSMEs, higher for micro enterprises and special categories

benefits.title: Handholding Support
benefits.description: Guidance and support to help MSMEs achieve Bronze, Silver or Gold ZED certification

otherCriteria: Udyam-registered micro, small and medium enterprises

customQuestions.question: Is your enterprise registered as an MSME under Udyam Registration?
Is your enterprise engaged in manufacturing?
Do you have a valid Udyam Registration Number?
Do you have the mobile number registered with Udyam?
Are you willing to take the ZED Pledge and participate in the ZED certification process?
Are you willing to undergo the required assessment/certification process?
Is your enterprise already registered under Udyam rather than only having an old UAM registration?

applicationProcess.description: Register on the ZED Certification portal
Site assessment by certified ZED assessors
Certification awarded based on assessment score (Bronze/Silver/Gold)

faqs.question: What is ZED certification?
faqs.answer: A certification recognising MSMEs for quality manufacturing with minimal environmental impact.

faqs.question: Is subsidy available for certification cost?
faqs.answer: Yes, a significant portion of the certification cost is subsidised, especially for micro enterprises.
